item.description:
Email cards now have a Send button. Séance puts the email in Mail on your Mac and sends it once you confirm with Face ID or Touch ID, from Mail's default account or the account named on the email's From: line. The card shows "Putting it in Mail…", then "Sending…", then "Sent" once it's in your Sent mailbox. Cancelling Face ID cancels the send. If Face ID doesn't come up, the approval card in the chat still works.
Send sends plain text, with bullets shown as •. To keep bold and links, use Copy Body as before. On the phone, Mail has moved into the card's More menu.
